text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Philippine firms have bought 20,000 tonnes of wheat from Argentina for January deliveries, traders said. Prices were less than the prevailing $195 per tonne for U.S. wheat but did not give further details.

WHEAT TENDERS - Morocco will tender on December 16 to import 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat, European grain traders said. The wheat is for delivery between January 1 and January 10, they said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Turkey's state grain board (TMO) opened a tender to import 200,000 tonnes of red and white milling wheat on Tuesday as planned, but a result was unlikely before the option closed on Thursday afternoon, a TMO official said. The tender was on a three-year credit basis and wheat from the U.S., Canada, Argentina, Australia and the European Union would be preferred, according to by TMO officials.

- Algeria has launched a tender to import 150,000 tonnes of French or U.S. or Argentine milling wheat, or any combination of the three, for shipment in January and February. The tender runs until Thursday.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan issued separate tenders on Monday for 270,000 tonnes of U.S. Grade 2 or better soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat for delivery between January 8-31. The Pakistani Ministry of Food and Agriculture invited bids to be opened at 1100 Pakistan Standard Time on December 22 and must remain valid until 1800 PST on December 23 for the supply of 270,000 tonnes U.S. soft white wheat in bulk plus/minus five percent buyer's option to be financed under the GSM 102 export program. In a separate tender, it invited bids to be opened at the same date and time, for the supply of 270,000 tonnes of Australian white milling wheat.

BARLEY TENDERS - Libya is in the market to import optional origin barley, European grain traders said on Tuesday. Over the past two weeks Libya has been asking exporters for barley prices but without providing details over tonnages or shipment dates sought, they said.

- Jordan will tender on Dec 19 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. feed barley or equivalent origin in one lot for shipment by end of January, traders said. They said offers must be received by Jordan's Ministry of Supply by December 19 with offers for U.S. origin under the GSM 102 programme.
BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission said it invited tenders for the supply of one cargo of 25,000 tonnes of feed barley, with the tender closing Tuesday December 17 and shipment in January.

RICE TENDER - Sri Lanka was undecided on Wednesday on awarding a tender for the import of 25,000 tonnes of white raw rice, an official for the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said. The CWE has received 20 offers for the tender, which closed last Friday, said the official who asked not to be named.

MARKET TALK - There was widespread talk in u.s. soymeal export market that China bought on Wednesday or Tuesday night 25,000 to 50,000 tonnes of u.s. soymeal for February shipment, however details of the deal could not be confirmed.

... Argentina is the major force at the moment in the world wheat market and is expected to export a record 10 million tonnes of wheat this marketing year, a major U.S. wheat growers group said Wednesday.
... Libya has donated 7,500 tonnes of bulk durum wheat to Iraq, Jordanian shipping sources said on Wednesday.
